explanation: Log disabling detected -- an attacker disabled system logs to hide malicious activity. The log_disable tag in Alert.xml is the flag consumers read: 0 means clean, 1 means logging was found disabled. No script that sets this tag to 1 was found in this bundle. errorlogcheck.sh is a related but distinct file, repairing corrupted ErrLogFile.xml rather than detecting deliberate log tampering.

known_patterns.meaning: Log disabling flagged -- system logging was found turned off or interfered with, a classic anti-forensics move to hide subsequent malicious activity.

evidence_sources.default_meaning: Clean -- system logging is active and no disabling was flagged.

metadata.writer_script: unknown -- no detection writer found in this bundle, only reset writers
metadata.caveat: Zero confirmed detectors for this specific tag. errorlogcheck.sh is defensive (repairs corrupted logs) not detective (doesn't flag deliberate tampering) -- don't confuse the two when tracing this attack type.
